capabilities.file_read: Read user-authorized documents, images, spreadsheets, and catalogues.
capabilities.web_search: Discover candidate URLs with language and geography-aware search.
capabilities.public_web_read: Read public pages without bypassing access controls.
capabilities.structured_data_transform: Normalize domains, validate records, deduplicate, and score.
capabilities.xlsx_write: Create and verify a five-sheet XLSX deliverable.
capabilities.browser_render: Render JavaScript-dependent public pages when ordinary fetch is insufficient.
capabilities.public_social_search: Discover publicly indexed social posts and official company profiles without bypassing access controls.
capabilities.authorized_social_api: Use user-provided approved platform/API access for repeatable social monitoring under current scopes and quotas.
capabilities.maps_places_search: Use an authorized maps/places service under its terms.
capabilities.licensed_contact_provider: Use a user-authorized contact database and retain provider status.
capabilities.licensed_trade_data: Use licensed import/trade data with entity and HS-code verification.
capabilities.email_validation: Use a permitted verification service; never send probe marketing messages.
capabilities.crm_write: Write approved records only after explicit user authorization.

degradation_rules.no_web_search: Accept candidate URLs/lists from the user and continue with verification.
degradation_rules.no_public_web_read: Stop at ICP and search-plan output.
degradation_rules.no_xlsx_write: Return schema-valid JSON or CSV plus a delivery limitation.
degradation_rules.no_maps_places_search: Use official sites, directories, associations, and exhibitor sources.
degradation_rules.no_social_api: Use public indexed social pages only, state partial coverage, and do not claim exhaustive monitoring.
